title: Improving Debugging in Verification-Aware Languages Through Automated Fault Localization: A Case Study in Dafny
abstract: arXiv:2608.05399v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verification-aware languages, like Dafny, integrate formal specifications directly into source code to enable static correctness checks. However, when verification fails, the feedback provided is often limited to the specific condition of the error, such as a violated postcondition, rather than the root cause of the fault. While Dafny's counterexample features provide concrete execution traces, these typically expose a single failing path per assertion failure, leaving the developer to manually look through the entire trace to locate the error.   This paper investigates automated fault localization for verification-aware languages by comparing two paradigms: state-based and counterexample-based localization. Our state-based localization strategy replicates the ``snapshot'' methodology of AutoFix by inferring invariants and predicates to identify suspicious program states. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.05399v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：验证感知语言（如Dafny）将形式化规范直接集成到源代码中，以实现静态正确性检查。然而，当验证失败时，所提供的反馈通常仅限于错误的具体条件（例如被违反的后置条件），而非故障的根本原因。虽然Dafny的反例功能提供了具体的执行轨迹，但这些轨迹通常在每次断言失败时仅暴露一条失败路径，导致开发人员必须手动查看整个轨迹才能定位错误。本文研究了验证感知语言的自动故障定位问题，并对两种范式进行了比较：基于状态的定位和基于反例的定位。我们的基于状态的定位策略复制了AutoFix的“快照”方法，通过推断不变式和谓词来识别可疑的程序状态。基于反例的策略则由一系列技术构成……
tldr: 本文针对Dafny等验证感知语言在验证失败时反馈信息有限的问题，比较了基于状态和基于反例两种自动故障定位范式，帮助开发人员更高效地找到程序错误的根本原因。
